The '''Carbos system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Roche sector/Legends|Roche sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carbos Thirteen]].
